chunks: We make their deeds attractive to those who do not believe in the Hereafter, so that they may wander in perplexity.
ai.seo_question: Why does God make the deeds of disbelievers appear attractive to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the concept of *tazyin* (divine beautification), where God actively enhances the appeal of worldly actions for those who deny the Hereafter, serving as a consequence of their spiritual blindness. This divine action leads them to *ya'mahoon* (wander aimlessly), reflecting a state of cognitive dissonance where they pursue fleeting desires while remaining unaware of the ultimate truth. The verse underscores the causal link between belief in the Afterlife and the clarity of one's perception of reality.
